name: daily-hunt
description: Daily tech product and open-source discovery digest. Fetches today's Product Hunt leaderboard and GitHub Trending top 10, then curates a personalized briefing in the user's preferred language using their memory/profile to highlight items most relevant to them. Use this skill whenever the user says "daily hunt", "今日猎奇", "tech digest", "daily digest", "what's trending", "今天有什么新产品", "PH today", "show me today's launches", "GitHub trending", "今日趋势", "morning briefing", "tech briefing", "daily brief", or any combination asking about Product Hunt + GitHub Trending together. Also trigger when the user asks about new product launches, trending repos, or wants a curated tech news digest. Even casual phrasing like "what's new in tech today" or "有什么好玩的项目" should trigger this skill.
